purpose: Operationalize the canonical 500 RUB soft target with explicit fit-scaled overage limits and deterministic history bands, without allowing deal quality to raise taste fit.

rules: price <= 500 RUB is within the base target regardless of history class
500 < price <= 650 RUB is allowed only when history quality is record, near_record, or good_vs_history
650 < price <= 750 RUB is allowed only when history quality is record or near_record
price <= 500 RUB is within the base target regardless of history class
500 < price <= 550 RUB is allowed only when history quality is record or near_record

marginal_or_below_moderate.note: These items normally never reach deal quality because the canonical taste threshold already excludes them; if encountered defensively, any price above 500 RUB fails closed.

user_price_tolerance.family_fit_rule: Use the highest final canonical taste fit among the included members of the already-resolved purchase family. Do not use feed recall flags, reviews, discount, or price to upgrade family fit.

history_quality.previously_free: Use the distinct previously_free class; never compute a paid delta from zero.
history_quality.unavailable_exact_history: Use unverified; do not invent or currency-convert a historical minimum.

purchase_decision.note: Purchase decision is assigned only after the fit-scaled price gate passes.

sorting.note_on_best_variant_value: Offer-family resolution already selected one best primary variant. Until a separate numeric variant-value score is canonically defined, stage 18 assigns equal tie score 0 rather than inventing a hidden heuristic; deterministic later sort keys still resolve order.

pass_requires: every current primary family receives exactly one deterministic disposition
history classes follow the numeric bands exactly
no zero historical value is used as paid delta
no item above its fit/history-gated maximum remains recommendation-eligible
sort is deterministic and has no artificial top-N
